title: Awake Thou That Sleepest
edition: Preached by Charles Wesley before the University of Oxford, 4 April 1742. John Wesley published it. The panel is the 1771 Pine printing.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. Charles Wesley preached this sermon in 1742, and John published it. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is his own Pine printing of the Works. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 3 in the 1771 Works. Charles Wesley preached it at Oxford, 4 April 1742. Ephesians 5:14.
